UTC Converter

Convert between UTC, your local time and any fixed UTC offset — with an honest note about daylight saving.

UTC → other zone

Your local time → UTC

⏰ Honest note: this tool uses fixed UTC offsets. It does not apply daylight saving time automatically — regions observing DST shift by an hour for part of the year, so pick the offset that's actually in effect on your date.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter a UTC date/time and pick a target offset — or enter your local time.
  2. Press Convert.
  3. Read the converted time with its offset label.
  4. Remember DST is not applied automatically.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which conversions are supported?

UTC → your local time, UTC → any chosen UTC offset, and your local time → UTC.

Does it handle daylight saving time?

No — it uses fixed offsets. Some regions shift by an hour for daylight saving, so always double-check meeting times for DST regions.

Which offsets can I pick?

All standard zones from UTC−12:00 to UTC+14:00, including half- and quarter-hour offsets like +5:30 and +5:45.
